definitions.explanation: Relating to actual substance or practical effect rather than form or appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{実質的|じっしつてき}な⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He is the de facto leader.

examples.japanese: {実質的|じっしつてき}な⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}られなかった→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実質的|じっしつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.notes: Uses adverbial form 実質的に

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {実質的|じっしつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (substantially, effectively)
- Noun: ⟦{実質|じっしつ}→実質：12282_jisshitsu⟧ (substance, essence)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {実質的|じっしつてき}な⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧／⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧ (substantial effect/meaning)
- {実質的|じっしつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ (essentially the same)
- {実質的|じっしつてき}な⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (de facto control)

USAGE: Emphasizes actual substance over nominal or superficial aspects. Often used to describe what is true in practice, even if not officially recognized.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本質的|ほんしつてき}→本質的：21259_honshitsuteki⟧: Essential, fundamental (about inherent nature)
- {実質的|じっしつてき}: Substantial, practical (about actual effect)
